text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's it for this year's summer camp…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: We have the autumn Tenno Sho and then the Arima Kinen coming up. Honestly, I have no idea how they'll turn out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But… I can't worry. I have to believe in myself. "Even one's greatest weaknesses can become one's strengths."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer, won't you stay with me for this final leg of my journey?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The bus will be arriving soon! I'd better gather everyone up!
Thus ends my sweltering summer camp with Fuji Kiseki.
